blocks.text: Hypothesis testing uses several important concepts to make correct decisions. Each concept has a specific role in testing. Understanding them avoids confusion. They guide acceptance or rejection of hypotheses. These concepts are used together. Proper knowledge improves accuracy. They are applied in data analysis. Learning these concepts is essential.
